purpose: Teach: 見せつけ/混じり/ふやす/腰掛け/役立た/焼か/溶かし/襲い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが家族愛を行動で見せつけられた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he showed his love for the family through his actions.
lines.style: Soft, searching tone. Long pauses between thoughts — not slow, but contemplative. Voice carries the weight of memory without heaviness. Almost speaking to himself, then remembering to include her.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、白髪混じりが渋かったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and those silver streaks in his hair were distinguished, weren't they, dear?
lines.style: Warm, gentle prompting. A knowing smile in the voice. She's not quite answering what he asked — she's circling back to her own memory, tenderly redirecting him. Soft cadence on the final word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが田畑をふやすため努力された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he worked so hard to expand the family fields.
lines.style: Voice settling deeper into recollection. Slight breath before 'he worked' — as if accessing something carefully stored. Deliberate pacing. The respect in the voice is quiet but unmissable.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、縁側に腰掛けて夕日をご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he'd sit on the veranda watching the sunset, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: A gentle divergence — she's offering him a different scene from the same time. Not correcting, but adding. Warm and knowing. Voice softens on the image of the veranda and sunset.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「役立たないと感じる時もあった」と仰った
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, there were times he said he felt he wasn't doing enough.
lines.style: Voice drops slightly — a moment of vulnerability folded into memory. He's trusting her with something tender. Pause before 'he felt' — letting the admission settle. Exhale carries the weight of doubt he's remembering.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お餅を炭火で焼かれるのが上手だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: But he was so skilled at roasting mochi over charcoal fire, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: A gentle counterpoint — she's offering concrete proof of his capability through a specific, sensory memory. Warm, almost playful. She's defending his father through fondness. Slight lift on 'mochi,' steadying on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが氷砂糖を溶かしてシロップを作られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he could make syrup by melting rock sugar.
lines.style: Another small skill surfaces — less grand than farming, but held with the same careful respect. Voice carries quiet admiration. This is not boasting; it's witnessing. Slight warmth on the act of creating something.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、嵐が襲い来た夜も冷静でいらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when the storm came that night, he stayed so calm, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Final image — a test of character. Her voice is steady, knowing. She's been waiting to circle back to this moment. The tone is almost relieved, as if confirming something important. Soft close on 'dear' — almost a sigh of completion.
